Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision
you reported in Pasadena, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just go by my first name for this, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me, in your own words, what happened?
A: I was changing lanes on the highway, moving into the right lane because the exit was coming up. I checked my
mirror and didn't see anything right beside me. When I started to move over, a pickup clipped the back corner of my
car and pushed me toward the shoulder.
Q: Was your turn signal on befroe you began moving over?
A: Yes, I'd had it on for a few seconds. I'm pretty sure of that.
Q: Did you see the pickup before the contact, or only after?
A: Only after. It seemed like it came up in my blind spot pretty fast. I heard a loud scrape and then felt the steering
wheel jerk.
Q: Did you stop at the scene, and were any police called?
A: I pulled onto the shoulder and stayed put. An officer came out and took information from both of us.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: My right wrist is broken. The doctor said it's a fracture, and I'm wearing a splint and I have a follow-up appointment
next week. My neck is sore too, but the wrist is the main thing.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to get my car looked at and I'd appreciate a call back about a rental.
Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
